description_en: Invoke this API to query the list of resolvers, including basic resolver information, startup status, creation time, and updated time.
description_zh: 调用该接口查询解析器列表信息，包括解析器基本信息、启动状态、创建时间和修改时间
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-parser --iot-instance-id iot-n8t0000 --page-size 10 --search-name DataParser --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListParser

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify this ID; otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.  

></notice>  

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
